title: Desktop images' thumbnails and metadata don't refresh immediately after being overwritten using GIMP's "File > Overwrite" command or other changes
line: Files on the desktop that are overwritten in place now update their thumbnail and size right away, without pressing F5.
explanation: Folder View lists desktop:/, which KIO does not watch itself; it relies on the desktopnotifier kded module to send change notifications. That module watched ~/Desktop with a QFileSystemWatcher, which only reports entries being added, removed or renamed, so a file rewritten in place (GIMP Overwrite, Spectacle saving) sent nothing and the item kept its old thumbnail and size until F5. The module now also watches the files in the desktop folder (and subfolders it is asked to watch) with KDirWatch and sends FilesChanged for a modified file, so the item and its preview are refreshed.

commits.message:
kioworkers/desktop: refresh desktop items when a file is rewritten in place

The desktop notifier only watched the Desktop folder for entries being
added or removed, so a file overwritten in place kept its old thumbnail
and size until F5. Also watch the files and send FilesChanged for them.

BUG: 501016

media.caption: Master: 26 s after overwriting it in place with a blue image, the thumbnail is still red
With the fix: 6 s after the same in-place overwrite, the thumbnail is blue

review.text: Correct cause: QFileSystemWatcher does not report in-place rewrites, so desktop:/ never got FilesChanged. Adding a KDirWatch with WatchFiles for the desktop and watched subfolders is the usual KDE tool for this, and the change is small. It could eventually replace the QFileSystemWatcher entirely, but keeping both is fine for a bugfix. Thumbnails refresh in the after media.
